Vendor Risk Assessment Model Documentation

PURPOSE:
Assess and score third-party vendors based on their risk profile to determine required due diligence level.

METHODOLOGY:
Statistical weighted scoring model using logistic regression trained on historical vendor failure data. Model estimates probability of vendor default or service disruption within 12 months.

TECHNICAL DETAILS:
- Inputs: 18 vendor attributes including financial health (liquidity ratio, leverage, profitability), operational metrics (incident frequency, response time), compliance status (audit findings, certifications), and business criticality
- Processing: Logistic regression model calculates risk score: P(Risk) = 1 / (1 + e^-(β0 + β1X1 + ... + β18X18))
- Outputs: Risk score (0-100), risk tier (Low/Medium/High/Critical), recommended due diligence level (Standard/Enhanced/Intensive)

PARAMETER ESTIMATION:
- Coefficients estimated using Maximum Likelihood Estimation on 3 years of historical vendor performance data (1,200 vendors)
- Training period: 2021-2023, validation: 2024
- Regularization: L2 (Ridge) to prevent overfitting
- Feature selection: Recursive Feature Elimination with cross-validation
- Re-estimation frequency: Annually or upon significant market changes

MODEL PERFORMANCE:
- AUC-ROC: 0.87 on validation set
- Accuracy: 82% at optimal threshold (0.35)
- Precision: 0.79, Recall: 0.76, F1: 0.77
- Calibration: Brier score 0.12, Hosmer-Lemeshow p-value 0.23

ASSUMPTIONS:
- Historical vendor failure patterns are representative of future risk
- Linear relationship between log-odds and input variables
- No perfect multicollinearity among variables
- Vendor data provided is accurate and timely

UNCERTAINTY QUANTIFICATION:
- 95% confidence intervals for each coefficient
- Prediction intervals for each vendor risk score (+/- 8 points)
- Model uncertainty captured via bootstrapping (1,000 iterations)
- Sensitivity analysis performed on key variables

VALIDATION:
- Out-of-time validation: 2024 vendor data (250 vendors)
- Cross-validation: 5-fold stratified
- Back-testing: Quarterly comparison of predicted vs actual vendor incidents
- Benchmarking: Compared against external vendor risk scores (BitSight, SecurityScorecard) - correlation 0.74
- Independent validation by Model Risk team completed Dec 2024
- Validation report: MRM-VAL-2024-089

BUSINESS USAGE:
- Determines due diligence requirements for new vendor onboarding
- Triggers enhanced monitoring for high-risk vendors
- Informs contract terms (indemnification, insurance requirements)
- Used by Vendor Management Office for all vendor relationships >$500k

MODEL GOVERNANCE:
- Registered in Enterprise Model Inventory (ID: MOD-VRM-042)
- Annual validation by independent team
- Monthly performance monitoring dashboard
- Model owner: Vendor Risk Analytics
- Model risk rating: Medium

This is a statistical model that uses logistic regression to predict vendor risk and inform risk management decisions.
